title: Recorded machine action
statement: Given a deterministic $k$-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet and record data, return the machine's transition action when the recorded state is present, using the recorded input and work-tape symbols. If the recorded state is absent, return an action that stays on the input and work tapes, writes nothing, emits nothing, and halts.
hypotheses_covered: A natural number $k$ of work tapes
A deterministic $k$-tape Turing machine over the binary alphabet
Record data containing an optional state, input symbol, and work-tape symbols
